description: A line comment inside a directive in a quoted template is ignored
notes: The spec allows comments inside template directives, but a line comment counts as a newline, and the spec doesn't say newlines are ignored inside directives. hashicorp/hcl ignores them: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false) before reading the directive, and its peeker skips comments.
